setup: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.join(process.env.PASEO_SOURCE_CHECKOUT_PATH,'packages/server/.env');const dest=path.join(process.env.PASEO_WORKTREE_PATH,'packages/server/.env');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,dest);}else{console.log('No packages/server/.env found in source checkout; skipping copy.');}"

app.command: cd packages/app && BROWSER=none EXPO_PUBLIC_LOCAL_DAEMON="localhost:${PASEO_SERVICE_DAEMON_PORT}" npx expo start --port $PASEO_PORT
